name: Constellia
desc:
The city of Constellia, once a gleaming City of Light, and the biggest of the Celestial Cities, gifted to the Lightborn by the Celestials as a last gift. Shortly after, the Celestials abandoned the city to never return. The Surface folk referred to the city as "The Guiding Star" and used it to traverse Lumen.

Constellia was guarded by Stone Knights created by the Celestials, which appeared in Lumen by falling from The Nightsea in radiant meteors.

After the Celestials fled the city, it was invaded by the Kyrsans under [Ethiron](entity:ethiron_the_maelstroms_eye)'s will, who destroyed the city and captured [Kaide, the Drowned Light](entity:kaide_the_drowned_light), the last king of Constellia.
additional_info: -   Currently, the only named Celestial City in [The Heavens](location:the_heavens).
